metamorphosis_result: Contract holds: Brief -> Concept Deck -> Client Pitch on one doc.clan; 3 distinct visual identities, 3 schema migrations via pack-html --schema (every generation validates), hop-1 brief and hop-2 concepts verbatim in final data, 3 pinned decisions, unbroken lineage. Rough edges: assets need re-passing through full-html replacement (F10); merge semantics of pack-html frontmatter undocumented so agents re-transcribed prior data (F11).
findings: F1 patch-data auto-appends 'unknown-agent / processed document' chain noise
F2 stale-view hint suggests clan render even for hand-authored full-html views (destructive)
F3 patch-data rejects UTF-8 BOM (PowerShell 5.1 Out-File default) with an unhelpful error
F4 viewer edit bridge persists instrumentation attrs and saves no-op patches
F5 full-html repack drops human/patches.yaml - fold superseded human patches into the decision chain
F6 prose keys (assumptions) collide across branches - default append policy or role prefixes
F7 fork copies parent context.md verbatim - branch agents see conflicting task instructions
F8 requirements.yaml (layer 5) unused - needs first-class commands
F9 create bootstraps a {type: object} stub schema - no field guidance, patch-schema never triggers naturally
F10 full-html replacement drops parent human/assets - auto-carry referenced assets or hint --assets
F11 pack-html frontmatter merge-patches data.yaml but docs never say so - agents re-transcribe prior data verbatim
F12 agents guess 'clan read decisions' - add as alias of read chain
